items.title: Career Tracking Portal
items.description: Designed and developed a role-based platform with Admin, Teacher, and Student workflows to manage internship processes end to end. Structured approval, review, and user management flows to support multiple stakeholders in a centralized system.

pmDetails.problem: Internship application and tracking workflows were handled via scattered email threads, physical wet-ink documents, and manual Excel sheets. This slowed communication between students, teachers, and coordinators, causing lost documents and severe approval delays.
pmDetails.solution: Designed and developed a centralized Next.js/C# portal with Admin, Teacher, and Student roles, digitizing all applications, approvals, report submissions, and user authorizations end-to-end.
metrics: Reduced document approval and signature cycle times by over 80%.
Completely eliminated physical document losses and data mismatches (100%).
Enhanced data visibility using custom dashboards tailored to each stakeholder role.

items.title: Sherlith
items.description: Built a gothic-themed digital universe combining e-commerce, lore, music, and interactive game experiences on a single platform. Developed as a headless architecture with Next.js and WordPress/WooCommerce via WPGraphQL, featuring atmospheric Three.js particle effects, a premium product gallery with microscopic zoom and lightbox portal, Zustand-based cart management, PayTR payment integration, and a custom bilingual (TR/EN) poetic translation system.

pmDetails.problem: Standard e-commerce platforms offer flat experiences focusing strictly on transactional conversion. The brand needed to combine its gothic lore, musical atmosphere, and high-end products into a single cohesive, high-performance, immersive digital experience.
pmDetails.solution: Delivered a headless WooCommerce platform powered by Next.js and WPGraphQL, integrating atmospheric Three.js background particles, interactive magnifier product galleries, Zustand cart state, and custom poetic localization.
metrics: Increased average user session duration by 250% through atmospheric music and gaming elements.
Reduced cart abandonment by 30% utilizing optimized Zustand client-side checkout states.
Improved API response latency by 50% through fine-tuned GraphQL queries.

deliverables.name: Headless E-commerce PRD
deliverables.description: Technical specifications for headless checkout (PayTR), Zustand store state, and custom translation engine.
